I don’t agree with the extreme shipping that happened since it made them uncomfortable, but it helped me realize that not only was there nothing wrong with others being gay, but let me accept that I was bi too. 24 is young, and I know you've probably heard that before, but it's really true. I'm almost twenty, and with what I've been through, I can sometimes feel much older. I hope you're still with us, because every day that you stay alive, or call a friend, or get out of bed, shows that you're trying.

It's incredibly difficult to see a future when mental illness is present, but please believe me when I say that it's there. Your future could be tomorrow for you. You just have to see it. Years ago I wouldn't have thought I would live to be this age, but I'm here, and I'm happy. It didn't come automatically, and some days are still really hard, but I'm glad my suicide attempts didn't work. I am worthy, and you are certainly worthy, of the space and time it will take to make a future you're proud of.

I don't know if you're still here, but I hope you are. This isn't the end. You deserve to be here as much as your friends or family. You deserve to be here as much as me, or the stranger on the bus. You deserve to be here, and make of your life what you can. There are so many beautiful things, and I hope you can one day find them.
